mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( user_id, password, name, phone, email, birth, job, gender ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{birth}, #{job}, #{gender} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, password, name, phone, email, birth, job, gender, subscribe, created_at, deleted, ai_count, role FROM member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
SELECT user_id AS userId, name, phone, email, birth, job, gender, subscribe, ai_count AS aiCount, role, created_at AS createdAt FROM member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{request.name}, phone = #{request.phone}, job = #{request.job}, gender = #{request.gender} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
